name: HTS Fabrication, Inc.
old_description: Since 1993 our design team, certified welders, and machine builders have been helping companies like 3M, B&G Foods, Toro, Crenlo and many others build efficient and ergonomic manufacturing facilities.
about:
HTS Fabrication, Inc. was founded in 1993 in Lakeville, Minnesota. The company operates as a solutions provider specializing in custom metal fabrication using aluminum and carbon steel to address production equipment issues and capital equipment needs.

The shop offers engineering and machine design, custom metal fabrication, machine assembly, material handling systems, and enamel and epoxy painting. Work ranges from simple components to complex capital equipment, built from customer prints or developed from concept through research and development.

Customers include large manufacturers such as 3M, B&G Foods, Toro, and Crenlo, for whom HTS builds production equipment, material handling products, and ergonomic manufacturing facilities. The company serves industries that require one-of-a-kind manufacturing and material handling solutions to improve production flow and employee safety.

HTS emphasizes its ability to create custom products not found in catalogs, backed by fast turnaround times and direct, one-on-one client collaboration to increase production efficiency.
